templates.name: Dockside Blackout
templates.setup: A station district loses power while submarines are docked and connected.

stages.crisis: Life support, locks, and docking clamps fail in different sections.
stages.aftermath: The crew must protect its vessel while helping restore the station.

complications: Someone uses the blackout for theft.
The station reactor is not the cause.
A hospital wing loses power.
opportunities: Station authorities pay for competent help.
templates.reward: Power returns and the crew gains payment or trust.
templates.failure: Supplies are stolen or the submarine takes dockside damage.
templates.persistent: The blackout's cause can become a station investigation.

templates.name: Critical Market Shortage
templates.setup: A station runs short of food, water, medicine, fuel, or repair stock.

stages.contact: Prices rise before officials admit the problem.
stages.crisis: Crowds, hoarding, and faction pressure destabilize distribution.
stages.aftermath: The crew must secure necessities without worsening the emergency.

complications: The shortage is manufactured.
A shipment is trapped nearby.
The crew holds exactly what the station needs.
opportunities: A fair solution earns lasting trust.
Supply-chain information reveals a profitable route.
templates.reward: The crew secures supplies and improves station stability.
templates.failure: Credits are lost and essential resources remain scarce.
templates.persistent: The station's prices and attitude reflect the crew's conduct.

templates.name: Station Security Lockdown
templates.setup: Station security seals districts, docks, and transit routes after a reported threat.

stages.crisis: The lockdown begins trapping civilians and compromising submarine operations.
stages.aftermath: The crew must choose between compliance, investigation, and direct intervention.

complications: The threat is inside security.
The lockdown hides a political purge.
The crew's submarine is designated evidence.
opportunities: Solving the crisis earns official access.
The real culprit carries valuable intelligence.
templates.reward: The crew leaves with its vessel, people, and legal position intact.
templates.failure: Delay, fines, confiscation, or violence follow.
templates.persistent: The station records the crew as trusted, suspect, or hostile.

templates.name: Station Labor Unrest
templates.setup: A strike, lockout, or work stoppage halts critical station services.

stages.contact: The dispute begins at the docks.
stages.crisis: A breakdown, provocation, or security action threatens lives.
stages.aftermath: The crew must decide whom it supports and what services truly cannot stop.

complications: Management falsified safety records.
A faction funds the unrest.
Saboteurs want both sides blamed.
opportunities: A fair settlement creates loyal contacts.
Repairing the underlying problem earns payment.
templates.reward: The crisis ends without sacrificing workers or station survival.
templates.failure: Violence and service loss consume credits and supplies.
templates.persistent: The station remembers whether the crew treated people as partners or obstacles.

templates.name: Phantom Sonar Contact
templates.setup: Sonar repeatedly paints a contact that no other sensor can confirm.

stages.contact: The contact matches the submarine's movement.
stages.crisis: It begins transmitting familiar sounds, voices, or identification codes.
stages.aftermath: The crew must test reality without following the signal into danger.

complications: Only one crew member can hear it.
The contact predicts nearby hazards.
A second submarine reports nothing.
opportunities: The signal reveals a real anomaly.
templates.reward: The crew maintains discipline and extracts useful data.
templates.failure: The contact lures the vessel off course and damages crew confidence.
templates.persistent: The signal may return using information learned from this encounter.

templates.name: Temporal Echo
templates.setup: The crew receives sensor data, radio calls, or physical evidence from moments that have not happened yet.

stages.contact: The first prediction is harmless and correct.
stages.aftermath: The crew must choose what evidence to trust without creating the disaster it observed.

complications: A future crew member begs them to turn back.
The echo records a successful route and a destroyed submarine.
Objects appear before they are recovered.
opportunities: The echo reveals a coming threat.
Data from two timelines advances research.
templates.reward: The expedition uses the echo without surrendering causality or command.
templates.failure: Conflicting actions cost time, readiness, and sanity.
templates.persistent: One unresolved prediction becomes a formal campaign clock.

templates.name: Alien Resonance
templates.setup: A low-frequency alien pattern synchronizes machinery, biology, and thought.

stages.crisis: The resonance influences movement, speech, and equipment cycles.
stages.aftermath: The crew must break synchronization before the vessel becomes part of the pattern.

complications: A crew member finds the effect comforting.
The pattern opens a ruin system.
The reactor amplifies it.
opportunities: The resonance can power or decode alien technology.
A contained sample becomes a research asset.
templates.reward: The crew interrupts the pattern and records it safely.
templates.failure: A system degrades and the crew suffers psychological pressure.
templates.persistent: Exposure may create recurring dreams, cult interest, or alien-system access.

templates.name: Identity Duplicate
templates.setup: The expedition encounters a person, transmission, or record that perfectly duplicates a living crew member.

stages.aftermath: The crew must prevent panic, murder, or replacement while determining what is real.

complications: Both may be genuine.
The duplicate arrived first.
A faction already recognizes the duplicate.
opportunities: The phenomenon exposes a larger anomaly.
The duplicate knows information the original lacks.
templates.reward: The crew preserves command and contains the phenomenon.
templates.failure: Trust collapses and the active character loses readiness and sanity.
templates.persistent: The duplicate question remains a persistent character and campaign thread.
